parameters.question: Determine HLA class I alleles (HLA-A, HLA-B, HLA-C) from a BAM file. Compare the HLA allele calls for all six loci (A1, A2, B1, B2, C1, C2) at 4-digit (2-field) resolution, e.g. A*02:01. Truncate higher-resolution calls such as A*02:01:01 to 2 fields. Ignore differences in the 'HLA-' prefix and in the order of the two alleles within a locus. Column order and extra columns (e.g. reads or objective scores) may differ.
